contradictions.explanation: With only three teams, Ben, Bo, and Isla being pairwise on different teams requires exactly three teams each holding one of them, which is consistent, but combined with Esme being the team captain (implying she belongs to one of these teams) it creates an unresolvable fourth-team requirement since Esme must join one of the three already fully occupied by Ben, Bo, and Isla individually while still being distinct as captain.
